title: Open Questions — Example Sheet
subtitle: A worked example of the format: three decisions I made on your behalf, each with the authored text it came from and what I would answer.
footer: Source documents: docs/example-data/. This page is the skill's worked example; replace every block with your own.

sections.heading: 1. Decisions with real consequences
sections.note: A stable code is immutable once issued and there is no rename operation, so a wrong code is permanent until someone builds one. That is why these are worth two minutes now.

blocks.title: Sourcing, Attendance, Overtime — reused, not minted

evidence.text: Three entries already had codes elsewhere in the corpus, so nothing new was invented:

evidence.code:
- **Sourcing & Screening Kandidat** — `HR/SOURCING-SCREENING`; jalur lanjutan setelah permintaan disetujui.
- **Absensi & Rekap Kehadiran** — `HR/ATTENDANCE-RECAP`; sumber tunggal hari kerja dan ketidakhadiran.

evidence.text: Listed for completeness only — a card with no options records a decision without asking for one.

blocks.title: Rekap Performance Kuartal is procedure P12 of the same FLOW

evidence.label: Related Flow says
evidence.code: - **Rekap Performance Kuartal** — `SATGAS/QUARTERLY-PERFORMANCE-RECAP`; konsolidasi SCORE per role menjadi dasar keputusan SDM CEO.

evidence.label: But the same document already runs it
evidence.code:
### P12 · INA Recap Quarterly Performance & Report to CEO — *Owner: INA*
12.3 Menyusun rekap performance per role.
12.4 Menyerahkan rekap performance kuartalan kepada CEO.

evidence.text: A FLOW listing itself as a related FLOW is a loop. Related Flow becomes derived from link sets, so this entry would be generated as a self-reference and then filtered out by hand.

options.title: Remove the entry; P12 already is the quarterly recap
options.why: No code is minted, and the corpus loses a self-reference it cannot derive.

options.title: Keep it — a separate quarterly recap SOP exists outside this document
options.why: Then the code stays and that SOP is authored later. Tell me its real name and I keep the mint.

blocks.text: **Block types available:** `card` (a full decision), `rules` (a run of one-line `<select>` rows), `note`, `text`, and `html` for anything the schema does not cover.

sections.heading: 2. Repeated small decisions
sections.note: Eighteen near-identical choices are unreadable as eighteen cards. One line each, one dropdown each, grouped by source document.

blocks.context: Tools: TL1 Google DRIVE · TL2 Google DOCS · TL3 Google SHEET · TL4 HRIS · TL5 WhatsApp

items.text: Tanggal efektif final hanya ditetapkan HOH pada P4.
items.why: Authority rule. Names a procedure, not a tool.

items.text: Akses sistem ditarik tepat pada tanggal efektif, tidak lebih awal dan tidak lebih lambat.
items.why: The system it revokes access to is not in this FLOW's tool list; ITS is a role.
